name: guest.comment
description: A guest's comment on the page a link opens: a name and words, both trimmed. Refused on a view-only link.
sql:
insert into brandbase.comments as c (id, brand_id, kind, target_id, name, text, created_at)
select gen_random_uuid()::text, l.brand_id, l.kind, l.target_id, btrim(:name), btrim(:text), :now::timestamptz
from brandbase.share_links l where l.token = :token
returning brandbase.camel(to_jsonb(c)) || jsonb_build_object('createdAt', brandbase.iso(c.created_at)) as result
